name: SikaBond SprayFix
paste:
SIKABOND® SPRAYFIX: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaBond® SprayFix, June 2025, Version 02.03 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/3/sikabond_sprayfix.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaBond® SprayFix where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (June 2025, Version 02.03).
1.2 Product description. SikaBond® SprayFix is a multipurpose, high performance, fast drying, mist spray adhesive designed to bond various materials, used for both temporary light and lasting high strength bonding applications.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. SikaBond® SprayFix can be used on many substrates, including:
    - Felts and fabrics
    - Paper and cardboard
    - Metals
    - Foams
    - Cork
    - Most plastics
    - Rubber
    - Fibreglass
    - Timber, plywood and particle board

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaBond® SprayFix
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: MULTIPURPOSE, HIGH STRENGTH, SPRAY ADHESIVE
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (June 2025, Version 02.03) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Low odour - suitable for indoor use
    - Easy to use
    - Even spray application
    - High initial tack
    - Fast drying
    - High strength
    - Repositionable for 1-2 minutes
    - Versatile – bonds well to many substrates
    - Upholstery
    - Furniture lamination
    - Art and craft work
    - General repairs
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Synthetic polymer
    - Colour: Opaque - Off White
2.5 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Pressing time: Apply even presurre to bonded surfaces for approximately 3 ~ 5 minutes
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 350g
    - Shelf life: 24 months from the date of production
    - Storage conditions: Must be stored in original, undamaged packaging, in dry conditions and out of direct sunlight, at temperatures between +10°C and +25°C

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (June 2025, Version 02.03) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate preparation. The surface must be clean, dry and free from oils, grease, dust and loose friable particles.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (June 2025, Version 02.03) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Consumption: Approximate coverage - 8m² for single side temporary bonding and 4m² for double sided permenant bonding
4.3 Application method / tools.
    - Shake the canister well for a minimum of 20 seconds before use.
    - Spray from a distance of about 20-30 cm, using a sweeping motion to get an even coverage of adhesive. For temporary low strength bonding, apply to only one surface. For high strength permanent bonding, apply adhesive to both surfaces. Allow the adhesive to become tacky before firmly pressing the surfaces together, applying even pressure along the entire bonding surface for 3 to 5 minutes. Pressing the surfaces together either while the adhesive is still wet or after it has lost its tack will result in a weak bond – the optimum time for bonding is when the adhesive is dry but still tacky. If required bonded materials may be repositioned within 1-2 minutes to ensure correct surface alignment.
4.4 Cleaning of equipment. Tools and uncured overspray may be cleaned with Sika® Colma Cleaner or other suitable solvent. Once cured, residual material can only be removed mechanically.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. +10 °C min / +40 °C max
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaBond® SprayFix, June 2025, Version 02.03, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/3/sikabond_sprayfix.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SikaBond® SprayFix, version 18/06/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/o/sds-sikabond-sprayfix.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
